name: Rhode Island
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Rhode Island's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward), including Block Island, which sets the south edge at 41.14. The east edge is Little Compton; the open Atlantic beyond Block Island and Sakonnet is trimmed. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ri.
